g.text: Maps: equal-participant means; white areas are outside the 22-sensor convex hull. Template sensor geometry.
Thin lines: all 9 participants; thick lines: participant means. Negative: lower task power. Positive: higher task power.
Fixed baseline −1.5 to −0.5 s; imagery +0.5 to +2.5 s relative to cue. No decoder fitting.
